candidate_order: Existing full-source manifests in saved rank/source order, then local database facts/issues metadata mechanism hits by line_number; source acquisition only for bounded eligible candidates. No results or labels used. Stable doc ID tiebreak.
eligibility: Civil property/possession matter with own source-grounded rules and 2-4 reconstruction targets, identity and complete-source provenance; uncertainty is not exclusion. Only metadata screening is not detailed source qualification.
grouping: same litigation/appeal/remand and known related suit one group; shared precedent alone not same dispute; uncertain linkage recorded; exposed groups TRAIN only, old8 REGRESSION; unseen eligible strata round-robin TRAIN/DEV/TEST using seeded group shuffle, reserve DEV/TEST before filling TRAIN
sealed: Deny IDs from existing split/exclusion manifests before reading body, never enumerate/read sealed payloads
source_policy: Exact located quotes do not establish semantic or legal approval; preserve claim/court/stage/object/time; full original, no metadata summary substitutes

training.loss: mean per request then per dispute
training.selection: DEV major false acceptance, confirmed support coverage, then lower cost; all seeds retained

stop: Training only after every data/QC gate passes. No TEST driven updates; no extra web answers without concrete DEV gain; no commit/push.
